name: Star-zigzag transformer
summary: A star-zigzag transformer combines a star-connected winding set with a zigzag-connected set.
description: A star-zigzag transformer combines a star-connected winding set with a zigzag-connected set. Its winding arrangement and neutral duties require the manufacturer's complete connection designation.
